dig_A_phase_recovery.verdict: FUNDAMENTALLY INFEASIBLE - and the wall IS the two-copy advantage
dig_A_phase_recovery.why: signed tr(Prho) of a high-weight sealed Pauli from SINGLE-COPY data has classical-shadow variance ~3^weight. weight-10 -> 3^10=59049x -> ~7e7 shots for SE 0.03 (we have 707k, ~90x short); weight 11-13 hopeless. This is not a data limit - it is EXACTLY why F122 uses two copies: the phase the two-copy squares away is classically UN-recoverable at high weight. The re-analysis re-derives the advantages foundation.
dig_A_phase_recovery.data_present: wave1-n10 kingston conv arm, 707k single-copy shots, sealed P YYXZXXXYZZ - present but the observable is exponentially out of reach

dig_B_S1_S3_reopener.verdict: NOT FEASIBLE on banked data - floor confirmed from the single-copy angle
dig_B_S1_S3_reopener.why: door-b cal is TWO-COPY (32-bit Bell), not single-copy readout; the only high-shot single-copy (wave conv) is on KINGSTON with ZERO qubit overlap with the marrakesh ghost qubits {17,24,25,27,28,29,37,45}. No matching single-copy readout on the ghost qubits exists -> re-confirms A2 S1_declaration from a new direction.

scan_close: both proposed digs rigorously determined and walled. Dig A hit a FUNDAMENTAL wall (single-copy exponential-in-weight variance = the two-copy advantages own foundation, re-derived from the re-analysis side); dig B hit a DATA wall (no single-copy on the ghost qubits). The $0 re-analysis program reaches its true floor - and naming WHY (the advantage is precisely the classical un-recoverability) is the deepest result of the collision-scan arc.
